_doc: Per-view caps from tiny-planet-perf/budget.md. Draw calls and triangles are hardware-independent, but villagers/pets move so a view drifts run to run on SwiftShader: a view fails only above cap * (1 + tolerance). Overrides are known, pre-existing overs (tracked, not to grow). mobile.forest used to override calls to 400; touch gather props now bake to two draws and the walk is under the 350 cap.
